_why: Whisper Almanac: a faceless YouTube channel (@whisperalmanac) voiced by the owner's own cloned whisper. Her rulings 5-6 Nov 2026, spry brain Settled decisions. Lead lane: whispered sleep SCIENCE (How We Know deep sea, food and materials; history secondary, her ruling 6 Nov 2026), 2-3 hour videos, rewritten for sleep from fact-checked How We Know scripts. Backup lane: money and love affirmations, 1 a week, same channel.

Read by loop/whisper_lane.py (scripts, checks, kits, the Mac night step), loop/whisper_author.py (the $0 cloud author) and voice/whisper_voice.py (Chatterbox, on the Mac, inside the batch's narrator lock). Nothing in this file is decoration: every key has a reader.
Fact-checked = uploaded by the How We Know machine (loop/state/ledger.json `published`, not retired): those scripts passed the source, citation and render gates.

channel.name: Whisper Almanac
channel.ai_voice_line: The voice is AI: a clone of the creator's own whisper, made with Chatterbox. The facts come from checked public sources.

sample.why: Chatterbox conditions on 10 seconds of the reference (voice/synth.py). 20-30 s of steady whispering lets the step pick the cleanest 10 s (synth.pick_voiced_window). Her sample stays on her Mac and never goes in a repo (her call 5 Nov).

voice.why: Lower exaggeration and cfg_weight than the How We Know read (0.4/0.4) for a flatter delivery; measured 6 Nov 2026 the register still spoke at 170 words a minute, so every chunk is slowed to 0.82 (pitch kept, ffmpeg atempo) and the pauses are long. Pauses and the slow-down are added in code: they cost no narration time on the Mac.

pacing.speech_wpm_basis: measured 6 Nov 2026: 170 words a minute from Chatterbox with this register (How We Know test voice), times the 0.82 tempo = 139; re-measured from her own voice on the first voiced episode

distinct.why: Every video is a distinct script (her call 6 Nov; mass-produced loops risk demonetisation). Overlap = share of a script's eight-word runs found in any other Whisper Almanac script.

visual.why: Her ruling 6 Nov 2026 (money case): dim, moving footage of the named subject, not a dark screen - the Sep 2026 demonetisation wave hit near-identical dark-screen sleep compilations. The How We Know long-form footage rules apply (a new shot at least every 20 s, no clip repeated within 3 minutes, no subject over ~25%), enforced by visuals/whisper_reel.reel_problems.

brand.why: The manifesting/sleep ASMR brand approved 6 Nov 2026 (one candle in a dark room, dark only; DM Serif Display italic lowercase for thumbnail words, Jost Light for the rest).

episodes.hook: A slow, whispered trip down through the dark ocean: why deep animals glow, why so many are red or clear, how they live under the weight of the sea, and what happens when a whale comes to rest on the sea floor.

A slow, whispered look at the strange animals of the deep sea: why they look the way they do, why some seem frightening and are not, how large a colossal squid really grows, and why deep fish change when they are brought up.

A slow, whispered walk through how people learned what they cannot touch: how far away other galaxies are, how old a shell or a stone is, how the dark sea floor was mapped, and how people reached the deepest place on Earth.
episodes.waits_for: footage of its own subjects for every part (galaxies, age dating, sea-floor mapping, Challenger Deep, the Mariana Trench): her call 6 Nov 2026, no part voiced or rendered without it. The nightly harvest grows the pool.

episodes.topic: science of steel, glass and iron
episodes.hook: A slow, whispered science lesson on the strong things around you: how steel gets its strength, why a blade is plunged into water, what made old swords famous, why some old iron never rusts, and how glass, concrete and the purest silicon are made.
episodes.waits_for: footage: materials holds 8 licence-checked clips; the reel rules need more (visuals/whisper_reel.py). The imagery-harvest lane grows the pool; until then this script is not voiced.

movements: settling in: breath, a soft body, a safe room
feeling safe and worthy right now
the kind of life you are building, calm and steady
gratitude for what is already here
drifting: fewer words, longer pauses, sleep
affirmations.guardrail_why: Affirmations only, never a guaranteed outcome; no fake income proof; no healing or health claims; the AI-voice line and the altered-content box on every upload (brand guardrail, approved 6 Nov 2026: law and YouTube policy, not taste).

split.why: Her ruling 6 Nov 2026: the Mac's narration nights split 5 to Whisper Almanac and 2 to How We Know long-form; How We Know Shorts keep going; re-check at day 30 (6 Dec 2026) with real views from both channels. Read by loop/night_split.py; the supply gates (loop/supply_gate.py) decide first. Monday is the food session's night and Friday the batch's deep sea and materials night.

upload.why: Read by loop/whisper_upload.py (the Mac, nightly batch step whisper-upload). Every episode is uploaded PRIVATE with a publish date, as How We Know does: 20:00 Central so it is live before bedtime in every US zone (master plan, 6 Nov 2026). 2 sleep episodes (Tue, Fri) and 1 affirmation (Sun) a week, the plan's starting cadence. The supply gate (her 12 Oct rule): no new upload of a format while 14+ days of it already wait on YouTube. min_lead_hours: a 2-hour video's processing time before its publish moment.
